proposed_rules.trigger: A thin full-width bar at the very top of the page, above the nav, with a [bg:color] background and a short promo message + link (e.g. product announcement).
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as global site chrome (announcement bar), exclude from the page's block inventory. If retained, model as a site-wide fragment, not per-page content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Appears above the nav as a persistent marketing ribbon injected site-wide, not document content.

proposed_rules.trigger: A text node whose content is raw CSS/JS source (starts with a comment like /* ... */ or contains selector/property syntax), rendered visibly due to an unclosed style/script or authoring error.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude entirely. It is a source-leak artifact, never content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Raw stylesheet text rendered into the page is a bug in the source site, not authorable content.

notes: Confirms C06 mixing (app-category/testimonial/pricing) is one EDS structure: announcement-bar + nav + hero(tabs). Label differences are not template differences.
